en.sayed-ali-raza: If you want, I will, as a second example, relate to you concerning Mūsā, the Interlocutor of Allāh (a.s.) when he said:
“O Allāh! I need whatever good Thou mayest grant me.” (Qur’ān, 28:24)

By Allāh, he asked Him only for bread to eat because he was used to eating the herbs of the earth, and the greenness of the herbs could be seen from the delicate skin of his belly due to his thinness and paucity of his flesh.
